chunks: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sam'ah, from Ibn Ribat, from Ibn Muskhan, from Abu al-Abbas, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him: A man divorced his wife while he was ill with one divorce, and he had previously divorced her twice. He said: 'Then she inherits him if he is in his illness.' I asked: 'What is the limit of the illness?' He said: 'He remains ill until he dies, even if that lasts for a year.'
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit her husband if he dies of the illness during which he issued her final divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the status of the 'final' divorce (talqah khamsah) when issued during a period of illness, establishing that the wife retains her right of inheritance if the husband dies before the iddah concludes. Shaykh al-Tusi highlights the Imam’s expansive definition of 'illness' as any continuous state of sickness from onset to death, ensuring the ruling applies regardless of duration. This ruling underscores the principle that the marital bond remains intact for inheritance purposes until the iddah period fully expires, even after the third divorce.
